full_text:
The Titan's Island is the sixth issue of the Huntik Magazine comic book series.

== Synopsis ==
The Huntik team leave for a new mission in America but Caine sends the Huntik Foundation jet crashing onto a mysterious island. Trapped in a strange valley, Lok and Cherit have to contend with a flock of Giant Birds, while Dante, Zhalia and Sophie are captured by the giant Titan, Polymaximus. With they be able to survive the dangers of wild land and the ambushes of the Organization?
